researchBoundary: Five derived results concern the actual initial-half, strict-past squared-loss FTL predictor. The first two are algebraic results for arbitrary real observation streams; they do not assert unit-game feasibility for those streams. The three limit results require one infinite stream with every observation in [0,1]. The fixed-comparator criterion is an equivalence of limits, not an assertion that either limit exists. The final result explicitly assumes empirical-mean convergence; its limit is an analysis parameter and never a learner input. A bounded oscillating-mean actual-FTL obstruction and the all-comparator converse remain separate source-reconciliation obligations. No probabilistic guarantee or nonnegative-regret assertion for arbitrary algorithms is proved. The original sixteen Chapter 1 source objects and unknown required proof total are retained. Other Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 obligations, unenumerated Chapters 3–16 and required appendices remain separate; no chapter or book completion is established.
